scope: Optional later increases researched for the proposed broad 50-US-gallon aquarium; original stocking remains the starting proposal.
assumptions: Qualitative adult bioload estimate including a modest colony of ordinary small ramshorns, established filtration and healthy planting. Actual tank volume, water chemistry and installed performance must be checked.
checks: Wait until the original fish have settled and several weeks of normal feeding, water tests and maintenance show a stable tank. There is no automatic date for adding fish.
Quarantine newcomers separately, choose healthy fish of reasonably similar size, and acclimate them appropriately.
Increase one species at a time. Check that every fish eats, ammonia and nitrite remain undetectable, nitrate trends are manageable, and weekly care stays near one hour.
Count surviving offspring and watch ramshorn population growth. Confirm stable water chemistry and mineral availability suitable for both fish and snail shells.

tanguar-haor-honey-gourami.comfortNote: Keep all four honey gouramis. Preserve about 90 cm of clear swimming length, calm planted retreats and two feeding spots. Every gourami must continue eating confidently.

kasumigaura-medaka-channel-margin.comfortNote: Count any surviving medaka offspring before buying more fish. Keep the planned cooler water and an open swimming area.

archer-vegetated-wetland-margin.comfortNote: Check the sex balance and tiny-food intake of every newcomer. Keep planted cover, open surface access and mature, stable water.

araguaia-ember-chain-sword-margin.comfortNote: Keep sheltered planting alongside open swimming room. Use appropriately small food and avoid substantially larger or boisterous tankmates.

apure-pristella-floodplain-margin.comfortNote: Preserve the open central swimming lane. Add a small batch first and reassess water quality and weekly maintenance before considering the upper end.

upper-paraguay-bodoquena-community.comfortNote: This option applies to the two-species plan without corys. Keep planted sight breaks for black phantom displays and increase one species at a time.

essequibo-small-creek-community.comfortNote: Keep the existing 12 glowlights. Preserve open swimming space around the Mayaca planting. This option applies to the two-species plan without pencilfish.

archer-threadfin-blue-eye.comfortNote: Optional addition: four threadfins, bringing the group from six to ten while keeping the existing twelve spotted blue-eyes. A larger threadfin group can support social confidence and display behavior. First confirm mature, stable water and reliable tiny-food intake by both groups. Keep a suitable sex balance, planted retreats and gentle circulation; watch for feeding competition and keep weekly care manageable.
